name: pdf-layout-translator
description: Translate text-based PDFs with an LLM while preserving page layout, images, vector graphics, and inline emphasis.

interface.shortDescription: Translate PDFs while preserving their layout.
interface.longDescription: Uses the active LLM to translate positioned PDF text, preserving images, vector graphics, alignment, and inline bold or italic emphasis.
defaultPrompt: Translate my attached PDF into French.
Translate this PDF into English and preserve its layout.
